revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and one schema misuse/duplication issue need fixing before ship: (1) In script_coverage's bill_collection entry, the customer quote 'Okay. I gotta look for my computer because I gotta log in.' is mistakenly timestamped at 03:11 — that timestamp belongs to the rep's bill-request line ('Alright. Well, yeah, the only thing we'll need from you...'); the customer's quote actually occurs at 05:11. Correct the customer_quote timestamp to 05:11 (or split the row's ts/end_ts more precisely: ask_ts 03:11 for the rep's ask, result at 05:11 for the customer's response). (2) cherry_pick_moments[3] ('objection_inversion_miss' at 02:40) misapplies the objection_inversion schema section to a moment where no objection was raised — this is a duplicate of cherry_pick_moments[2]'s bill-anchoring miss and should either be removed or re-tagged under coaching_philosophy.bill_anchoring to avoid double-counting the same gap under two different frameworks. Additionally, on rerun: reconcile the inconsistency between interest_reason_audit (reason_used: no) and cherry_pick_moments[1] (which treats the 01:56 battery question as at least partial pickup of the same backup-power motivator) — pick one consistent read. Consider adding a brief note on the non-standard intro framing ('request to remove the solar') as a possible schema-drift/script-mismatch flag, and a numeric_discipline flag on the unqualified 'guarantees savings within the first year' claim at 02:52, per the schema's numeric_discipline directive. These are targeted fixes; the trajectory read, outcome reclassification, and overall coaching priorities are otherwise well-grounded and should be preserved.
